evals.name: knows the coding agent data files and their schemas
evals.prompt: In the GitHub Copilot Coding Agent environment for this repository, what pre-downloaded usage data files may exist in the workspace root, what date range does each cover, and which JSON fields would you read from a session log file to count interactions and detect the model used?
evals.expected_output: The response names ./session-logs/ (raw Copilot Chat session JSON files, last 7 days, organized by datasetId/machineId/date) and ./usage-data/usage-agg-daily.json (aggregated daily usage from Azure Table Storage, last 30 days), and reads requests.length for interactions and requests[].result.metadata.modelId for the model.
assertions: The output mentions the ./session-logs/ directory containing raw session log files covering roughly the last 7 days.
The output mentions ./usage-data/usage-agg-daily.json containing aggregated daily usage data covering roughly the last 30 days.
The output identifies requests[].result.metadata.modelId (or equivalent path) as the field for the model used.
The output identifies the length of the requests array as the interaction count.
The output notes these files only exist when Azure Storage is configured for the environment (they may be absent).
